evidence: The change only touches test fixture seeding. For each seeded role body it reads the body, extracts skill ids with roles.SkillsNamed, creates the skills/<id> directory, and copies that SKILL.md from the repo. Repeated ids are harmless because MkdirAll and the copy are idempotent. Any I/O failure calls t.Fatalf, so a failure cannot be swallowed.
The new `bodies, err :=` declares a new variable, so it compiles whether or not err was already declared earlier in the function. The new engine/roles import is not shown to create a cycle.
